title: 10eLotto draw
description: The evening 10eLotto draw tied to Lotto, derived from the Lotto draw of the same date. A key is present only from the date the option existed.

date.description: Draw date (Europe/Rome), ISO 8601. The same date as the Lotto draw.

contest.description: Official concorso number, the same as the Lotto draw.

gold.description: Numero Oro: the first number drawn on Bari. From 2014-06-26.

double_gold.description: The second number of Doppio Oro: the second number drawn on Bari. From 2017-10-03.

extra.description: The 15 Extra numbers, ascending; none is in 'numbers'. From 2021-10-21.
